'''Shewski High Destiny Hunt Down (HD)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Shewski]]
* '''Published:''' 6 July 2004 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Prepared Defenses|DS2-D-prepareddefenses.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Fear Is My Ally|Ref3-D-fearismyally.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS6 HD Shewski DS 2004 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Bossk (V) (Virtual Set 5), Lando Calrissian (V) (Virtual Set 6), Hound's Tooth (V) (Virtual Set 5), Imperial Decree (V) (Virtual Set 6), The Emperor's Prize (V) (Virtual Set 6), Ability, Ability, Ability (V) (Virtual Set 6), Punishing One (V) (Virtual Set 5), Mist Hunter (V) (Virtual Set 5): not in GEMP)

== Introduction ==

This deck aims to win via steady direct damage coupled with high destiny for battling away the Jedi.

== Notes ==

* Visage Of The Emperor appears in Starting and again x2 under Effects (3 total); dested as posted.
* Original-era (V): Bossk (V), Punishing One (V), Mist Hunter (V), Hound's Tooth (V) (VS5); Lando Calrissian (V), Imperial Decree (V), The Emperor's Prize (V), Ability, Ability, Ability (V) (VS6). For Punishing One and Lando, ovs_pick returned a VS7+ printing (sets 7+ default to legal from 2004-06-01); used the latest VS1-6 printing instead.
* Unique cards posted x2 (Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; Darth Vader; Emperor Palpatine; Boba Fett, Bounty Hunter; Darth Maul With Lightsaber) dested as posted.

== Strategy ==

Well, this is my first attempt at the HD decktype. In one tournament afternoon, I already learned a lot about how to run this deck more effectively.

First off, Visage is your friend and your curse. If it gets canceled, you may want to not redeploy it, depending on the game situation.

Onto the deck! First off, up your activation by pulling Carida with YCHF. I typically like going for solid play, so if I am able I may ditch that effect to get Combat Response (assuming I didn’t start it). If you are frozen by DDTA, don’t worry too much. You can get presence at a system pretty easily otherwise through your 4 ships.

Pull a DB and either drop down Vader or B4 to pull Vader to flip. The DBs are chosen since the BFDB is a great trap location and the DSDB since you can use Put All Sections there. Never forget to enforce Visage damage when you are flipped… if you forget on the 0 side, it’s not as bad.

From there you can play it by ear. You can set up Firepower (V) quite nicely, which is huge for making Vader more than just a card on the table. You also can set up S & D pretty easily, which is good for more direct damage and great versus a space heavy deck.

This deck has very nice destiny (see below). Use it with the Fish to maximize damage or make some shots with Dengar or P-59 easier. Some nifty high destiny cards are Put All Sections, which blanks Rebels at a D* site, and This is Some Rescue, which cancels OOC and the pesky space evasion favorite Alternatives to Fighting.

There are some v6 cards in here that are a bit unusual but work with this decktype. The Emperor’s Prize deploys on Vader if Luke is on the table but not with him and pings the LS. This is great for playing vs Speeders, where Luke will be at a battleground in most cases but not out in the open.

Thanks for reading and reviewing!
